metadata.title: What to Look For When Buying a Used G-Wagon (Rust, Known Issues, Engine & More)
metadata.description:
Buying a used G-Wagon? This is exactly what to look for. Follow along for this complete pre-purchase inspection and test drive for used G-Wagons (Mercedes G-Class). We cover known issues, rust, engine, suspension, test drive, and more. 

Thanks to Joe, the G Wagon Expert at Alliance Auto Care in Loveland, CO, for helping prepare our Buyer's Guide (link below) and for helping me on this series. Have a dream G Wagon build? 

CONTACT JOE: 
https://allianceautocare.com/ 
[email redacted] 
[phone redacted] 

Watch all the videos in this Buyer's & Build series in this playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHeawKfarQSPKIjpe86at3Ttc2sz7uD_b

FREE G-Wagon's Buyer's Guide: https://docs.google.com/document/d/12AuluAdmYzX5J3fkvwb2Vcos9EYJr1mSu7M1WzFkAhE/edit?usp=sharing

#gwagen  #gwagon  #gclass  #gwheeln #offroad #4x4 #mercedes4x4
